description: A small, barefoot boy stands behind iron bars, shown full figure facing the viewer. He has brown hair, pink skin, a bare chest with scrapes, and torn dark blue trousers. Beside him on the right, also behind the bars, stands a much larger adult in a sleeveless green tunic, cut off at the neck by the top of the picture, one hand on its hip and a gold ornament at the throat. Grey vertical bars run in front of both and a horizontal crossbar runs along the top. The background is pure black. The mood is sad and confined. Frame 1: the boy grips a bar with one hand, his other arm hanging. Frame 2: he reaches his free hand out to the side. Frame 3: he draws the hand to his chest, very briefly. Frame 4: he lifts the hand to his cheek. Frame 5: he rubs at his eye as if wiping a tear. Frame 6: the hand rests on his cheek again. The loop reads as a short, nervous gesture of a frightened child wiping away tears.
title: Weeping boy behind prison bars
